relationships.subject: pregabalin
relationships.evidence_quote: pregabalin treatment reduced both 15 g and 26 g filament-evoked activation of the ACC, contralateral Ins/SII and bilateral thalamus

relationships.subject: aprepitant
relationships.evidence_quote: Treatment with aprepitant reduced 15 g filament-evoked activation of the left, ipsilateral thalamus

relationships.subject: peripheral nerve injury
relationships.evidence_quote: significant activation of the anterior cingulate cortex (ACC) and the contralateral insular/secondary somatosensory cortex (Ins/SII) was observed following stimulation of the ipsilateral foot

key_findings: Non-noxious stimulation activated ACC, contralateral Ins/SII and thalamus after macaque sciatic nerve injury
Pregabalin but not aprepitant robustly suppressed evoked activation across time points
